## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes on a Mac with Safari (or the PR says why not)
- [ ] The code matches the surrounding code and adds no dependency
- [ ] New or changed tools are updated in the README tools table
- [ ] User-visible change: added a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
